title: CoreWeave Unsecured Notes Hit 1,000 bps Spread for First Time

tickers.name: CoreWeave, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Unsecured debt from CoreWeave reached a yield of 15.1% on October 13 as investors flagged insolvency risks for the AI data center operator. The bonds' spread over Treasuries widened to 1,000 basis points, causing the instruments to appear in CCC collateralized loan obligations and signaling a likely credit downgrade to CCC.

The high-yield market is pricing a decline in the value of the H100 GPU fleet that serves as collateral for the company's senior loans, which sit above these unsecured notes. List rental prices for H100 chips have dropped about 12% in one month, leading some traders to view the debt spike as a correction to the hardware's actual value. Other investors argue the bonds are mispriced and represent a buying opportunity.
